headline.zh-CN: 统一前后端的评审规则与匿名显示
headline.en: Unified review rules and anonymous display across the app

summary.zh-CN: 本次更新将分散在前端的评审进度、权限判断、匿名编号等规则统一收归后端计算并下发，修正了多处因前后端各自实现而产生的行为不一致：匿名用户编号现在全站一致，曲目详情页只显示当前工作流周期的问题，母带视图不再遗漏终审阶段的问题标记。
summary.en: This release moves review progress, permission checks, and anonymous tokens to backend-computed values, fixing several inconsistencies caused by duplicated frontend implementations: anonymous user tokens are now consistent everywhere, the track detail page only shows issues from the current workflow cycle, and the mastering view no longer misses final-review issue markers.

title.zh-CN: 匿名用户编号全站一致
title.en: Anonymous user tokens are now consistent

description.zh-CN: 此前同一用户的匿名编号（#后跟的字符）在不同页面可能显示不同，因为前端和后端用了两套算法。现在匿名编号统一由后端生成并随数据下发，同一用户在任何页面看到的编号都相同。
description.en: Previously the same user's anonymous token (the characters after #) could differ between pages because the frontend and backend used two different algorithms. Tokens are now generated by the backend and delivered with the data, so a user appears with the same token on every page.

title.zh-CN: 曲目详情页只显示当前周期的问题
title.en: Track detail shows only current-cycle issues

description.zh-CN: 曲目重新开始母带流程后，详情页此前仍会列出上一工作流周期的历史问题，与评审页、母带页的行为不一致。现在详情页与其他页面保持一致，只展示当前周期的问题。
description.en: After a track restarted its mastering cycle, the detail page still listed issues from the previous workflow cycle, unlike the review and mastering pages. The detail page now matches the other pages and only shows issues from the current cycle.

title.zh-CN: 母带视图不再遗漏终审阶段的问题标记
title.en: Mastering view no longer misses final-review markers

description.zh-CN: 母带视图的试听标记列表和批量操作栏此前不会显示终审（final review）阶段创建的问题，现在已与其他视图保持一致，全部正常显示。
description.en: The mastering view's marker list and batch action bar previously omitted issues created during the final review phase. They are now displayed consistently with the other views.

title.zh-CN: 终审通过与重新打开的判断与自定义工作流兼容
title.en: Final approval and reopen checks now respect custom workflows

description.zh-CN: 此前终审通过按钮和曲目重新打开权限部分依赖硬编码的状态判断，在使用自定义工作流的专辑中可能出现按钮该出现时不出现的情况。现在这些判断统一由后端按实际工作流配置计算，自定义工作流下也能正确显示。
description.en: The final-approval button and track-reopen permission previously relied partly on hard-coded status checks, which could hide actions in albums using custom workflows. These checks are now computed by the backend from the actual workflow configuration, so the correct actions appear for custom workflows too.

title.zh-CN: 评审进度与权限改由后端统一计算
title.en: Review progress and permissions now computed by the backend

description.zh-CN: 评审完成数、法定人数（quorum）是否达成、当前用户是否为曲目作曲者等信息，现在由后端随曲目数据直接下发，前端不再自行推算，各页面显示口径一致。
description.en: Review completion counts, quorum status, and whether the current user is a track composer are now delivered by the backend with the track data instead of being re-derived on the frontend, keeping every page consistent.
